_docs: Product photo registry for GadgetGeeks Pro. Maps phone models to REAL product cutout images. These are actual Apple/Samsung renders and professional product photos — NOT AI-generated. LENS and CANVAS use this registry to select real product images instead of asking AI to render phones (which always looks fake). Rule 25 in operations-rulebook.json enforces this.

photo_sources.shopify_cdn: Upload via image_gen.upload_to_shopify() for CDN URLs
photo_sources.notes: Product cutouts are transparent-background PNGs or white-background JPGs. These are the ONLY phone images that should appear in final posts. AI generates backgrounds/scenes — real photos provide the phones.

iphone_13.description: iPhone 13 product bundle — multiple angles, accessories, professional product photo

iphone_14.description: iPhone 14 product bundle — multiple angles, accessories, professional product photo

instructions_for_missing: For models without real product photos: (1) Use Apple/Samsung official press renders if available. (2) Screenshot product from gadgetgeekspro.com product pages. (3) Use AI for BACKGROUND ONLY — composite real product photo on top. (4) NEVER ask AI to generate the phone itself.

image_pipeline_rules.product_hero_shots: MUST use real product photo from this registry. AI generates NOTHING for product hero.
image_pipeline_rules.lifestyle_composite: AI generates the SCENE (person, environment, lighting). Real product photo composited in via Canva/Pillow.
image_pipeline_rules.deal_urgency: MUST use real product photo. AI generates background gradient/lighting only if needed.
image_pipeline_rules.comparison: MUST use real product photos for both sides. AI generates NOTHING.
image_pipeline_rules.sustainability: AI generates the SCENE (hands, plants, desk). Real product photo composited in.
image_pipeline_rules.blog_headers: AI can generate full scene IF no phone is prominently featured. If phone is visible, use real photo composite.
